description.zh:
自定义类型，取值：

- landmark：自定义地标。

- object：自定义物体。
description.en:
Custom type. Valid values:  

- landmark: Custom landmark.  

- object: Custom object.

description.zh: 自定义库描述，最长支持128字节。
description.en: Custom library description. The description can be up to 128 bytes in length.

description.zh: 自定义库名称，最长支持64字节。
description.en: Custom library name. The name can be up to 64 bytes in length.

descriptions.zh:
- 本接口目前支持的地域为华北2（北京）、华东2（上海）、华东1（杭州），其他地域暂不支持。
- 自注册object/landmark使用方法（以object为例）：分别创建自定义object库、自定义obiect实体，创建完成后注册自定义object实体图片，注册完成后创建包含自注册object库的模板A，再使用模板A提交分析任务，最终查询结果。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~342832~~)。
descriptions.en:
- This API currently supports the following regions: China (Beijing), China (Shanghai), and China (Hangzhou). Other regions are not supported at this time.  
- Procedure for self-registering objects or landmarks (using object as an example): Create a custom object library and a custom object entity. After creation, register images of the custom object entity. Once registration is complete, create a template A that includes the self-registered object library, then submit an analysis job using template A, and finally query the result.

## queries per second (QPS) limit
The per-user QPS limit for this API is 50 requests per second. If you exceed this limit, your API calls will be subject to rate limiting, which may impact your business. Please invoke the API appropriately. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~342832~~).

example.legacyCli: aliyun mts CreateCustomGroup --region cn-hangzhou --CustomGroupName Landmark_test_library --Algorithm landmark --CustomGroupDescription Used_for_landmark_test
